<!-- stormworks-research-gap:category:Engines -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts#engines).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Self-contained diesel engines differ by an engine_max_force field of 20000, 60000 and 200000; their runtime curves were not decoded, unlike the modular engine.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/4/summary`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> The classic engine update was not decompiled; prefer the modular engine article for recovered formulas.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/4/limitations/0`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> engine_max_force is 20000 for the small, 60000 for the medium and 200000 for the large diesel engine; the turbine engine has 100000. These are definition values whose use in the classic engine code was not traced.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/4/sections/1/body`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Torque and fuel use against throttle for each engine; temperature rise per throttle level.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/4/sections/2/body`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.
title: Engines: decode remaining behavior and formulas
